findings.title: Step 3's 'Record, and nothing more' list omits the skill-folder/name data that Step 4's matrix requires
findings.detail: The Step 3 operator checklist listed only marker yes/no, the sidecar-marker-b copy, version, session type, and date, while Step 4 reports skill names and folders per client.
findings.suggested_fix: Add one bullet to the Step 3 'Record' list: 'Which skill names and source folders the client's structured output (or reference panel) showed.'
findings.reason: Added the suggested bullet to the Step 3 Record list; the same reviewer re-read the list and confirmed the finding resolved with no new finding.
